items.title: OpenAI Scholars 2021: Final projects
items.summary: We’re proud to announce that the 2021 class of OpenAI Scholars has completed our six-month mentorship program and have produced an open-source research project with stipends and support from OpenAI.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI公布了2021年度OpenAI Scholars项目的结业及开源研究成果。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于人才培养与社区资助项目公告，不涉及模型架构或技术本身的实质突破。
